title: pimpinella involucrata
intro: Pimpinella involucrata, commonly known as Bumelia or False Beech, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pimpinella involucrata include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pimpinella involucrata include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
